bindings.predicate: The only traversal-consequence path composes synthesize_model, eval_gap, evaluate_next, separate construction-intent/evidence admission, and evaluate_action, preserving exact target authority, causal ledger support and reason-sensitive closure/next-action results.
obligations: A0/A4a: bind each function exact row; shared actor/library/module does not share authority. No prompt/CLI/service/postflight/query alternative decision path.

A1/A1a: worksite/process/artifacts are observations; closure and evaluation use admitted ledger truth. W can change without conformance and L is not all W. Contrary current observations require admission/currentness uncertainty before dependent closure/selection; unresolved interpretation prevents current reliance without erasing history.

A1a/A1b: every closure-relevant F_P callout, including evaluator work, enters immutable L/E before affecting routing/closure; corrections append/supersede. Evaluation attends only admitted rows reachable by declared lineage/predecessors/target/policy/event cursor, not ambient memory or archives.

A2/A3: before invocation bind exact outcome and optional bounded basis to gap/target assets/roles/evidence; rank only published lawful catalog actions. Unpublished needed action yields typed no-action, not broad fallback.

A4: handle initial selection, post-yield same-edge lawful resume, post-close graph continuation/no-action and post-retry/repair/reenter/block by higher-priority lawful action, else lawful graph following, else reprice/block for missing authority, else typed no-action. Unresolved post_reprice always no-action until separately admitted exact new basis supplies initial/basis-bearing resume.
A5: F_P may inspect/reason/draft/transform/propose within action but cannot close, append runtime events, mutate ledger or decide re-entry; actual F_D/ABG/Product admission owns those durable facts.

A6/A7: assess complete edge predicate fixed by TargetObligationBinding and required evidence before action; admissible reliance is not edge fitness and target cannot shrink after action. edge_converged true needs satisfied complete closure, not counts/liveness/artifact presence; false/open keeps the actual failed/unresolved result. Ledger selects no action.

A8: close/yield/retry/repair/re-enter/reprice/block are replay-visible domain decisions with basis/reason; lawful decision, edge fitness and lawful next selection are separate predicates. Decision satisfaction needs actual admission/mandate. close needs satisfied complete edge predicate; every violation remains falsified even with productive treatment.

A9/A10: yield requires same lawful edge/attempt, admitted progress or waiting and replay-visible resume; it adds no failure classification. Liveness/inactivity/interruption alone establish neither semantic failure nor closure.

A11/A12: evaluate_action may propose repair/re-enter disposition; evaluate_next chooses its published action. Public query renders read-only gap/decision/selection outputs and cannot append/invoke/admit/run evaluate_action/select traversal.

A13/A13a: replay reconstructs decisions from exact event/execution/intent/model/outcome/bounded basis/gap/target/catalog/evidence/ledger/decision/next-basis/policy. Each governing carrier carries reachable causal predecessor refs; reconstruction requiring external joins fails carrier replayability.
A13: resume acquires sufficient current reachable ledger subset; reconcile material partial/unknown effects before dependent repeat. Lost response proves neither non-start nor completion.

A14: every published inner vector obeys the full loop recursively with visible local carriers; opaque bounded internals may use local computation but cannot secretly publish/dispatch/retry/repair/reenter/close graph work.

A15/A16: ABG owns runtime/control; Product owns domain/catalog/gap/priority. Design modules cannot fragment evaluator authority. Applicable axioms constrain the selected outcome/causal cone; checklist wording cannot weaken them or authorize horizontal Product growth.

Terminal control reasons: after accepted outcome, discharged prerequisite, resolved experiment decision, other admitted terminal condition, or exhausted/rejected/withdrawn/superseded/repriced/falsified basis, select no further material work without new admission. Reprice requests constitutional re-entry; it cannot select successor outcome.

Stop returns actual outcome/task predicate: completion evidence satisfies, known unmet requirement falsifies, undecided exhausted/withdrawn work is indeterminate; preserve basis/scope diagnoses, effects and outstanding obligations. Lawful stop/no-action is not Product completion.

Gap missing/partial/blocked/waiting/ambiguous are data. Correctly characterizing a missing asset may satisfy eval_gap while its Product obligation is unfulfilled. Artifact/method/selection/decision/fitness predicates remain distinct.
permissions_exceptions: Concrete carrier names/realizations may differ while preserving the complete relation.
Shared function libraries do not merge authorities.
Current accepted relations and still-valid evaluations may be reused; no whole-history context requirement.
Opaque internal algorithms remain permitted inside one bounded action.
Ledger-as-attention is structural analogy, not transformer implementation dependence.
